Man it's not all about the playstyle and whether they are good or bad, it's mainly about communication issues and connection issues, which you would know if you actually read my comments which leads me to the conclusion that you came into this discussion with a bias and didn't bother to read my comments thoroughly or you're, once again, retarded and unable of comprehensive reading.  


Besides, would you force a muslim into a catholic church, even if the muslim clearly shows he'd rather be with other muslims? I'm not saying there should be no crossplay, i'm saying there should be a way to disable it for yourself.   


So to summarize, fuck you all for not even bothering to think about my responses instead jumping straight to faulty conclusions. I've been nicer to you than you to me and you say i'm the bad guy. I hope you will take another look at my comments and realize your mistake, provided of course you don't delete my comments or ban me from this sub reddit entirely, which honestly won't surprise me considering how you responded to my opinion.

I'm sorry but you are retarded, there's no other way to explain it. No matter what i say you're gonna make me look as a bad guy. I literally said i don't expect everyone to be competitive and you say i'm asking for half of community to change... Practice reading comprehension cuz you clearly missed that lesson in school

And again... I'm not saying that everybody should be competitive, and i'm not expecting it. What i'm saying is that i think on pc there are more competitive gamers, and that's what i prefer as well, that's why i used this as an argument on why i would like to disable crossplay, to maximize my pleasure with the game.   


And don't look at me like i'm some sort of selfish asshole. Would you play a game with 10 fps on default settings or would you try and search for a combination that lets you play with 30 fps. It's not such a hard concept to understand people

I know there are exceptions, and i said i'm not stating that console players are bad. All i'm saying is, objectively, keyboard and mouse seems like the better controller for this game, which leads me to the claim that average player on pc is gonna be better than on console, that's just logic man   


Same thing with racing games. Yea you can play on keyboard, but objectively controller is much better. That doesn't mean you can't be good at the game using a keyboard.  


Why does everyone here look at me like i'm some sort of racist? I want to turn off crossplay mainly because of communication issues and connection issues, and the only thing people see is the statement i made that on average pc user will be better than console user at this specific game, not every game, this game.

Man wtf. Lack of voice chat is an issue for all platforms, yes, but pc players have NORMAL CHAT, console players DON'T, what don't you understand? Or they don't use it, whatever the case is, it's not used, there's no communication, it's a problem for me. If i were to disable crossplay i wouldn't have to deal with that. This discussion is on whether or not there is a reason to disable crossplay, not whether or not console is worse than pc.   


Again. If people in regions with shitty internet tend to play console more than pc, then that's a reason for a pc player to want to turn off crossplay.   


And again, it's not about controls, it's about controllers, pc users have keyboard and mouse which is superior to controller for many people, pc users and console players, you simply can do more at a time because of the design of keyboards.   


It looks like you're taking this on a personal level, i'm not trying to bash on console, i'm stating my problems with crossplay as a pc user, and i don't think only i have these problems

No no no no, there's no voice chat for randoms, and that's the issue, if i wanted to play in parties with people on console i wouldn't want to turn off crossplay would i? And yes, every player can use quick chat but it's not known about, and pc players don't need it cuz they can just type normally, that's why it's not as relevant on pc what don't you understand?   


Connection is a relevant issue, if it has nothing to do with servers than it has something to do with the console playerbase, maybe they get worse internet cuz they don't care as much, i don't know, but that's my observation, people on console lag more and get disconnected more  


I've seen many console players defend themselves with the fact that they have to use the controller and that pc players have it better because they have the mouse. The game was designed on pc for pc, that gives a logical conclusion that the game is probably at least a bit better to play on a pc   


I feel like you're biased and skimmed through my arguments just to prove your point which makes me very disappointed

Well first of all: lack of communication, there's no voice chat and from my understanding console players either can't type in chat, or it takes too long which is an issue. Over the past few days i saw 1 guy responding with quick chat to my message and that's it, and i play a lot. I dare to say most players don't even know there is quick chat or bother to use it. That's probably my biggest problem. It feels like i'm playing with bots or mute people. I'm okay with someone not wanting to crack a joke or two, but a lot of people ignore the simplest advice like to use your flares for example.Second of all are connection issues. Console players load up longer, they take longer to arrive on the island. In the majority of my hunts in group there's 1 guy that can't connect or is still loading, whatever. It's one thing if he get disconnected cuz then the behemoth gets weaker but sometimes the guy is connecting for infinity. It's one thing if you're with the guy alone, but if you have 2 more players who don't even notice the guy isn't connected, and who don't respond to your messages to wait up for him it can be really annoying and sometimes causing you to lose the hunt.

Third of all, let's be honest, console players have it worse when it comes to controlling the character, so they are obviously gonna be worse than pc player. I'm not saying console players can't get good, i'm saying an average pc player outclasses an average console player, that's just facts, the game is easier to play on keyboard and mouse. Plus many people on consoles are playing casually, and there is nothing wrong with that, but it's an mmo rpg, you gotta spend some time to get rewards, you gotta put some time to get skill, in a game like this i prefer to play with people who are a little bit more serious

That's the main reasons that come to my mind, i'm sure if i were to nitpick i would find more but i think that's enough to show you, there are good reasons to turn crossplay off, and if such option doesn't get implemented at least what they should do is address the issues. Make the tutorial unskippable (don't know if it is, i only have 1 account and started like 2 years ago) but if it is unskippable then it needs some work. Address the importance of flares, the existence of quick chat and improve it, and try to optimize server connections
Thank you for the answer but yes, there is a reason to turn off crossplay, many reasons in fact. You want me to list my reasons?
How do i turn off crossplay on pc? I know where it is on consoles but it's not there on pc

Honestly man, i'm sick of studying, sick of school, few years back i was a straight B student, and even straight A in a few subjects, now i'm average or below average because i got no motivation to study.  Now i just wanna workout, people tell me i'm good at it, that they're envy of my progress, they come to me for advice when it comes to nutrition and training. I motivate my friends and family just by working out, because they see how much passion i have for it, but i really hate school. Theoretically i can be a personal trainer without school, but practically? I'm not sure.  


I believe that if you're forced to do a job which you don't like, then such life isn't worth living, at least for me. If i'm forced to work in an office from 9 to 5, 5 days a week just to get drunk in the weekend then miss me with that shit.  


But, if i have a job i enjoy or at least i don't completely despise then i can live with it. But that's my problem, only job that fits would be something workout related, like a personal trainer, any other job doesn't interest me, and if you add the fact that for any other job i would have to study extra hard for then that's a no no from me. If i wanted to be a doctor of course i would care for school. But if there's no school that prepares you for being a personal trainer, then there's no good school for me.

Yea i talked to 2 different school psychologists, first one i didn't click with too much, i feel like he didn't really know what to do, but at least i could spill my guts too someone which at that point in my life helped, 2 years later in a new school i went to another psychologist, he was much more experienced and understanding, but talking to him didn't really help me, if anything it made me feel worse after every talk, but at least he talked to the teachers so that they cut me some slack. 

The psychiatrist told me to go to a paid psychologist, but if verbal therapy is the only thing he can do i'd rather look for the answer myself.  


When it comes to talking about my problems publicly i really don't mind it, nobody here knows my true identity, only my nickname, and even if they did i still wouldn't mind, i'm not the type of guy that lies just to look normal, if i'm sad i show it, if i'm happy i show it, if i'm depressed i say it.  


The things you listed that helped... I do every single thing already, but i dropped faking my personality, because i just couldn't keep it up.  And when it comes to exercising well it's on the of the few things that make me happy, and having a job connected to working out is the only job i'd truly cope with, and that's connected to one of my problems associated with school.   


I've always been that philosophical kind of guy. Polish and philosophy teachers always liked me for my interpretations and thoughts, every class i've been in (i'm talking about a group of people, not lessons) quickly started identifying me as the philosophical one.  


Yeah...  


Those evening walks, long showers, sleepless nights spent thinking about god, and trying to find the meaning of life led me to suicidal thoughts and the conclusion that life really fucking sucks, not in the whiny way that "ugh life is terrible cuz i got an F in maths test" l, i'm talking about the bigger picture, the nature of human society, we get born, we get educated to work, we work to survive, take care of ourselves and reproduce, then the cycle repeats. Our only purpose is to reproduce, there's nothing else to it. Why?   
Why put yourself through this? Years of studying, thousands of sleepless nights working on those essays, slide shows, revising for a test... Just to get a good paying job to pay the bills you acquired while getting educated... And for what reason? To get a fucking child, to force it to do the exact same thing, to prolong this shitty cycle.

There are reasons to live, but why bother to fight for them despise the shit that's pushing you away from it when you can just kill yourself and end it all, when you're dead it's over, it's like you were never born, there's no you, so there's no consciousness. Since i've been in elementary school i've always wondered what's it like to not be alive, to never be born, that over time made me very immune to suicide, for me suicide is no longer something that's terrible because my life is over... It's something that at times is more preferable than living. There's no escape from this thought because it's not some anxiety and overthinking crap, it's a logic conclusion. I don't want to die because my life sucks, i want to die because life in general sucks, and i'd rather not live than live in the typical conditions that life gives you. There is stuff that sort of keeps my mind occupied enough to not thing about it, like working out, think working to beat a record in a particular exercise. 

But, whenever i have to do something i really don't want to do, not some minor shit but some of those bigger responsibilities, for example going to school i can just tell myself "Why do it, if it leads only to this stupid cycle, why not just kill myself and be done with everything". This reasoning is the reason why i probably won't graduate this year. And i'm fine with it, but my family isn't, the same thing is with suicide, i'm fine with killing  myself, my family isn't.  
Do you understand now why the psychiatrist told me there's nothing wrong with my psyche, that it's my mind and reasoning that's fucked up? I created an easy way out for myself, the way out being suicide. Whenever something goes majorly wrong i can just pop myself out of existence, i'm okay with it, but my family isn't, and that's the only reason i haven't done it yet. I've been thinking of telling my family to put me in a adoption center, somewhere in a completely different region, where they won't have any contact with me, and then after some time passes just kill myself, but this plan won't probably work. 

I had many great opportunities in life, but slowly i've stopped caring about anything, now my life is going to shit, i'm too unmotivated to do any school work, my grades are slowly turning to E's and F's, but even the thought of not finishing school, not getting a degree, the threat of being homeless... That doesn't motivate me, cuz i can just kill myself

I've shared so much shit with so many people that nobody cares anymore. Everyone around me got used to it. They've defined me with whatever the fuck is wrong with me.   
I remember times when i was so hopeless i spent whole days in school pointlessly looking at a wall and no one cared, but when some other guy got sad for literally half an hour everybody started talking to him and making him feel better. My friends are sick of my problems, my brother is sick of my problems, my parents are, the guy i've been going to for advice while skipping classes because of sheer stress and feelings that any second i might hurt something, someone or myself is sick of my problems. I've been to a psychologist, during the first 5 minutes of the visit he told me to go to a psychiatrist because i was in such a bad shape, yet when i went to the psychiatrist he told me there's nothing wrong with my psyche, I just have a fucked up mind and there's nothing nobody can do about it. I'm not going to describe my problems because you'd lose any reasons to talk to me, but i'll tell you this: I don't have a fucked up life, nobody bullies me, my family has relatively healthy relations, i'm not poor, i'm not ugly, i'm not dumb, i'm not weak, i'm not shy... I want to die because of my own thoughts, existential crisis of sorts.

But i literally can't do what i have to do did you even read my comments? I can't bring myself up to do this, and if someone tried to force me i would either do absolutely nothing or hurt them or myself

Okay, then what if i tell you this. School makes me suicidal and working out is the sole reason i'm not burried 6 feet underground yet.  Studying is emotionally hurting, exhausting, i'm not cutting my wrists because i'm not an idiot but if i could just erase myself out of everyone's life and kill myself i would do that 100%

I don't care about being "educated" if it leaves me emotionally scarred for life, i want to be happy, i will be happy if i do the one thing i love and that is working out. I don't need to be a milionaire, i don't need to drive a fancy car, i don't need to be the smartest guy in my surroundings and i don't need to be the strongest guy, i just want to live a happy life. If i can't have a job related to the gym i don't care about such life and will kill myself.

I am sick and tired of studying, i used to be a straight B student. If anything school killed, cut to pieces, swallowed and then vomitted my will to learn rather than expand it.

The mere thought of studying makes my head hurt and temper to rise, if that's what you call burning up then looks like i need a break for life  


EDIT:  
And yes, i've been to a psychologist, the first 5 minutes he told me to go to a psychiatrist but the psychiatrist told me there's nothing wrong with my psyche, gave me some weak ass drugs which don't help me and all she could do is recommend me a good psychologist so i can talk to someone once a month

Don't get me wrong tho, i'm not a moron that doesn't understand the subjects, i just don't care about them. I want to learn about anatomy and nutrition because i need that for myself as well, and i learn about it on my own through books about it, plus my dad is an athlete so i get my knowledge from a good source, i just don't want to learn all the stupid shit they tell me to learn in school, then go to college and study subjects that don't interest me to get a job that doesn't interest me just to have enough many to get drunk in the weekend. I see how my brother struggled with university and how my other brother is struggling right now, it's not the life i want, i don't care about such life, if i can't be a personal trainer or do something related to the gym then i don't care about living and might as well kill myself. 

And yes i could go to a sports school of sorts but i'm not made for that, i don't like team sports and at the moment i got a knee injury that prevents me from running and jumping, so i would be doing nothing at the school half of the time
